question: The word "hazardous" means:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (2)** i.e. Harmful and dangerous.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"hazardous"** means something that is harmful or dangerous and poses a risk to health or safety. (हानिकारक और खतरनाक)

 
 
• **Example: **Handling hazardous chemicals without proper protection can be very risky.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Harmful and dangerous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained:

 
• **Safe and secure** (सुरक्षित और संरक्षित):

 
 
• **Example: **The facility is designed to be safe and secure against external threats.
 
 
 
• **Easily manageable** (आसानी से प्रबंधनीय):
 
 
• **Example: **With the right tools, the project became easily manageable.
 
 
 
• **Reusable** (पुनःप्रयोज्य):
 
 
• **Example: **Reusable bags help reduce plastic waste.
 
 

4c:Te7e,
The correct answer is '**Option 2**&am
